# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform support restored**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.155.0 release restores Linux system-font discovery and updates Tizen native packages for Tizen 10. Linux applications using the NoDependencies packages can again discover fonts installed on the system, while Tizen consumers receive native assets built with the supported toolchain.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system fonts discovered again** — NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again locate and use fonts installed on the host system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen 10 native packages refreshed** — Tizen native assets are now built and packaged with the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
